Animations.Name: Vocals Loop
Animations.Observation: Vocals performance with the existing held prop.
Animations.Interpretation: The singer shifts weight, turns and lifts the head with each phrase and gestures from the elbow with the free hand; the microphone stays at the lips as the head moves.

Animations.Name: Tambourine Loop
Animations.Observation: Raised rim hold with deliberate free-hand taps and small wrist shakes.
Animations.Interpretation: The drum is held in front of the chest with its face outward and its ribbons down; the free palm draws back, strikes and bounces off the skin on the beat while the knees, head and a tapping heel keep time, and the wrist shakes the jingles between strikes.
